items.english: "That's right. Tired and troubled and made to suffer day by day by one thing and another, two years are already past. In a little while {t:boya} will be walking too."
notes: Kept 'two years are already past' literal though the marriage count elsewhere is three years; not harmonised per reading.

options: "{t:boya}." kept as ledger token for view-dependent rendering
alternatives.what_would_settle: Editor ruling on boya for a stated girl: keep Japanese with note or render as generic baby English

items.english: The man looked at the child standing there holding the spoon with nothing to do. She at once cried gladly, "{t:boya}." And at the same moment the child gave a great cry, and looking at her mother's face, "Umma-umma-umma-umma," banged the spoon down on the {t:table}.
notes: Grouped p29-p31 as one English paragraph: p29-s2 hangs on p30 speech and p30 hangs on p31 babble and banging.
Kept babble as quoted sound, no italics in draft; address kept as {t:boya} token, not fixed to boy/girl.

items.english: The young father hurriedly put {t:rice} into the child's mouth.
They at last laid down their chopsticks.
"Just a little while longer." The man said it strongly, as if to himself.
notes: Kept as quoted mutter with tag, practical and parallel, not shared understanding.

items.english: "Yes, let us work, shall we." She said it calmly, with {t:rest}. And holding the child on her lap, she put out her small nipple and began to nurse.
notes: 安らかに rendered via {t:rest} token to keep rest/peace chord; feminine polite carried by soft 'Yes, let us ... shall we' without ennobling.

items.english: "Come, let us clear up what is left. And let us sleep; tomorrow let us get up early, shall we?"
notes: Speaker given as father at medium confidence; draft keeps bare quoted resolve without attribution to avoid committing beyond tag.

items.english: At last the man stood up. And as he was about to begin clearing the {t:table}, the child had already closed her eyes with her cheek against the breast. All around had fallen quiet.
notes: Kept quiet for 静まりかへった to hold quiet chord; same {t:table} word as supper tableau.

items.english: "It's a {t:storm}." The man stopped still and whispered.
notes: Kept final line bare and verbally linked to opening frame, nothing solved.

data.say: Drafted the closing supper through the whispered storm keeping dialogue plain, repetitions literal, and vision unclarified.
